query: INSERT INTO source_circuit_breakers (source_id, state, failure_count, last_failure_at, next_retry_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(source_id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state, failure_count=excluded.failure_count, last_failure_at=excluded.last_failure_at, next_retry_at=excluded.next_retry_at
